intents: Troubleshoot the 3-node linear topology where pc1 cannot reach pc2 because the r1-to-pc2 link starts down.
pc1 already uses 10.0.1.2/24 on eth1 and has a route to 10.0.2.0/24 via 10.0.1.1.
pc2 already uses 10.0.2.2/24 on eth1 and has a route to 10.0.1.0/24 via 10.0.2.1.
On r1, assign 10.0.1.1/24 to eth1 and 10.0.2.1/24 to eth2.
Do not modify management connectivity on eth0.
ground_truth_reasoning: The endpoint addressing and static routes are already present, but r1 eth2 starts administratively down, so the pc2-side segment cannot carry traffic. The fix is to bring r1 eth2 up, assign r1 the two gateway addresses, and enable IPv4 forwarding so packets can traverse the router between the two /24 networks.
